Method of Attack: Phishing emails containing malicious attachments that deploy malware payloads
Subsequent installation by Emotet to open reverse shell to Ryuk operators after data exfiltration
Manual deployment of ransomware payloads on network devices using PowerShell Empire or PSExec after reconnaissance and gaining admin credentials
Impacted Systems: UHS healthcare systems including behavioral and acute care health hospitals
Hospitals and healthcare providers in the US and UK
Attack Vector: Network access gained through Emotet and TrickBot trojans
Manual deployment by attackers after gaining admin credentials
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note reading 'Shadow of the Universe'
Detection of Emotet and TrickBot trojans on systems
